text: Added portable scalafim.linalg first-order protocols and kernels for proximal gradient, projected gradient, linear-composite primal-dual solving, deterministic capability selection, and exact linear-reduction verification. Certificates bind primal/dual summaries, objective, residuals, iteration count, tolerance, and settings. multivar now depends on linalg, compiles semantic composite plans through a matrix-free Op-to-LinearMap adapter, and independently validates L1 KKT evidence; the old domain-local iteration kernel is removed. Null-space parameterizations carry the generic linalg reduction certificate. Unsupported capabilities fail before operator evaluation. Full linalg: 51/51 JVM and 51/51 JS. Full multivar: 329/329 JVM and 329/329 JS. Diff check clean.
